tasks.objective: Reproduce the current local typecheck, unit-test, build, and Biome status.
evidence_required: Exit status and summary for each command

tasks.objective: Identify the next bounded implementation task from verified beta blockers.

expected_outputs: Risk-ranked next task with exact proof boundary

A beta blocker requires credentials or provider access
